verification.notes: The source appearance was reviewed at 00:16:58. A later Piers Morgan transcript repeats Owens' account that Erika Kirk said Charlie had not received such messages and records Owens saying Erika later clarified the issue. Current searches did not locate the original Glenn Beck segment needed to verify the exact venue, wording, and context, so the specific claim remains unverifiable.
